identity: A slider task uses labeled handles, value readouts, and sometimes player controls or star ratings to set requested values.

scenarios.name: horizontal
scenarios.screen: A labeled horizontal slider shows one handle on a track and its current value in a readout.
never: A second handle on the scored track

arrangements.text: The label sits above the horizontal track, with the value readout at the track's right end.
The label sits to the left of the horizontal track, with the value readout above the handle.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and readout placement

scenarios.hint: Show a horizontal slider with visible draggable thumb, readable endpoints and read-only current value. Target is in range and thumb is off target. No editable numeric field.

scenarios.name: vertical
scenarios.screen: Vertical slider tracks stand side by side. Each has a handle, a label, and a current-value readout.

arrangements.text: The vertical tracks stand side by side, with labels below them and readouts above them.
The vertical tracks stand side by side, with each label above its track and its readout below.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and readout placement

scenarios.hint: Show a tall vertical slider with visible draggable thumb, readable endpoints and read-only current value. Target is in range and thumb is off target.

scenarios.name: log
scenarios.screen: A labeled slider shows one handle and a current-value readout on a logarithmic scale.
never: A second handle on the scored track

arrangements.text: The label sits above the track, and the readout sits at the track's right end.
The label sits to the left of the track, and the readout sits above the handle.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and readout placement

scenarios.hint: Show a visibly logarithmic slider with multiplicative ticks (for example 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000) spanning the target. Current thumb position and readout agree; target remains unmet.

scenarios.name: range
scenarios.screen: A labeled range slider shows two handles on one track, marking the current lower and upper endpoints.
never: Two separate tracks for the two endpoints

arrangements.text: The label sits above the track, with the two endpoint values beside their handles.
The label sits to the left of the track, with the endpoint values below the track.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and value placement

scenarios.hint: Show one slider track with two separate draggable handles, ordered lower and upper values, both starting off target. Range contains both requested target values.

scenarios.name: multi
scenarios.screen: Three separately labeled sliders each show one handle and a current-value readout.
never: A shared handle for all settings

arrangements.text: The three sliders form a vertical list, with each label above its track and its readout to the right.
The three sliders form a vertical list, with labels in a left column, tracks in the middle, and readouts in a right column.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and readout placement

scenarios.hint: Show exactly the requested labeled sliders with coherent scales covering each target including negatives when named. All thumbs off target; no editable numeric fields.

scenarios.name: stops
scenarios.screen: A labeled slider has one handle and named stops along its track; the handle rests at a stop.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the track, and the stop names sit beneath their positions along it.
The label sits to the left of the track, and the stop names sit above their positions along it.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and stop-name placement

scenarios.name: media
scenarios.screen: A video player shows its media area, a seek bar with a time readout, and a volume slider. One of the two sliders is the requested control.
never: A seek handle beyond the end of the bar

arrangements.text: The seek bar sits beneath the media area, with its time readout beside it and the volume slider below.
The seek bar sits beneath the media area, with the volume slider to its right and the time readout below.

scenarios.name: mixer
scenarios.screen: Five labeled channel faders stand side by side, each with a vertical track, one handle, and a level readout.
never: A single master handle in place of the channel faders
A fader handle outside its track

arrangements.text: The faders stand in one row, with channel labels below the tracks and level readouts above them.
The faders stand in one row, with channel labels above the tracks and level readouts below them.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: label and readout placement

scenarios.name: match
scenarios.screen: Two labeled sliders show their current values beside a presets card that lists named presets and their values.
never: Preset values hidden from the card

arrangements.text: The sliders form a vertical list to the left of the presets card.
The presets card sits above a vertical list of sliders.

scenarios.name: player
scenarios.screen: A video player shows a seek bar, a volume slider, and mute and captions buttons with their current states.
never: A seek handle beyond the end of the bar

arrangements.text: The seek bar sits beneath the media area; the volume slider and the two buttons sit in a row below it.
The seek bar sits beneath the media area; the volume slider and the two buttons sit to its right.

scenarios.name: rating
scenarios.screen: Two named rating rows show five stars apiece, with each row displaying its current whole-star or half-star value.
never: More than five stars in a row

arrangements.text: The rating rows stack vertically, with each row's name to the left of its five stars.
The rating rows stack vertically, with each row's name above its five stars.
